issue.title: UModal doesn't trap focus when opened
issue.body:
### Environment

- @acme/ui: 1.3.2
- Vue: 3.5.13
- Nuxt: 3.14.0

### Description

When `UModal` opens, pressing Tab moves focus behind the modal instead of staying inside it. Keyboard users can tab into the page content while the modal is still visible.

### Reproduction

https://stackblitz.com/edit/acme-ui-starter-8f2k1q

I just opened the starter and added a button that opens a modal, nothing else changed.

### Expected behavior

Focus should stay trapped inside the modal until it closes.
